name: Review
description: Approval-gated review queue: channel publish approvals, price-change review, quality holds, lifecycle/archive decisions, and spec-claim citations, linked to a product. The operator's decision (approve/request_changes/block) is written directly onto this row -- there is no separate decisions.json-equivalent bucket. Execution fields record the agent's follow-up outside the app after approval. `type: "spec_claim"` (see product-hub-model.js) flags a specification claim the agent extracted from an uploaded document without a clear page/section citation -- any products field or certificates row whose source-note doesn't cite a specific document+location should get one of these before it is trusted on a customer-facing quote.

agentPrompts.label: What's waiting for my review?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-product-hub` skill in this folder, then summarize the open review items — group by type (channel publish, price change, quality hold, lifecycle/archive, spec_claim) and flag the riskiest ones first.

agentPrompts.label: Record my decision on a review item
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-product-hub` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then record my decision (approve / request_changes / block) and note on the review item I name. This only records the decision in Busabase — publishing a channel, changing a price, lifting a hold, or archiving a SKU still happens as a separate follow-up outside the app after approval.

agentPrompts.label: Flag an unsourced spec claim
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-product-hub` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then create a `spec_claim` review item for the product fact or certificate I describe that lacks a clear document + page/section citation, so it isn't trusted on a customer-facing quote until verified.
